notes.title: Square Word: Hello Winter is here!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/36422902/f0d9c0d98fc0d9690586f1db333e189e8e089b4f.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone,

Winter is winter, let's welcome it (since we don't have the choice) and enjoy a nice and casual game, at home, under a blanket!

As usual: 
- Four themes!
- 140+ words to find!
- Progressive difficulty!
- Daily Challenge
- More hint than ever (click on the snowflake on the main menu!!!)
- New stamps!
- New songs!

To celebrate Winter and upcoming Christmas the game is 25% off !
AND you can have an additional reduction in the bundle!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2615510/Square_Word_Hello_Winter/
